canonical_system_definition: ENTITY is a provider-independent digital authority, information, evidence, market, economic and recovery operating fabric. Sovereignty protects continuity of authority and state across providers; it is not the definition of the whole product.

version_and_evidence_policy.historical_inherited_release_evidence: ENTITY v3.4.2 and other exact historical artifacts retain their original version labels; unchanged-scope inheritance is not a fresh v3.4.3 execution
version_and_evidence_policy.external_independent_evidence: Evidence controlled by an unrelated contributor, implementer, assessor or external organization remains separate from BTG-controlled qualification
version_and_evidence_policy.developer_reference_rule: Current implementation/API pages use the supported runtime label and immutable v3.4.3 tagged source or exact release commit. Historical reproduction pages use the exact historical target that produced the evidence.

tutorial_model: The primary tutorial track teaches ENTITY itself from the five primitives outward. External contribution work is retained as a real-world case study rather than the definition or spine of the tutorial curriculum.
code_tutorial_model: Executable source-grounded tutorials with recorded command transcripts, browser-safe terminal replays for tutorials 6-13, and fail-closed negative controls; generated identifiers may vary while documented invariants must hold.
recipe_model: Recipes are minimal source-grounded examples. They load exact current source paths where numbered directories are not conventional Python packages, preserve fail-closed negative tests, and do not present conceptual adoption routes as deployed hosted services.
case_study_recording_model: External fix campaigns preserve reproducible command/output evidence from pre-code authorization through upstream state. Video is optional and cannot replace command evidence.
core_tutorial_invariant: Core tutorials must teach ENTITY platform capability independently of any one campaign and keep ENTITY, authority, rights, events/evidence, value/settlement and recovery as separately verifiable state.

community_model.audience: developers and users building, integrating, evaluating, operating or using ENTITY
community_model.routing: Discussions for questions, ideas, evaluation and design conversation; Issues for reproducible defects/ambiguities/bounded work; Pull Requests for concrete reviewable changes; SECURITY.md for sensitive reports
community_model.evidence_rule: Community posts must not collapse implemented, locally tested, BTG-qualified, externally reproduced, independently implemented/validated, upstream accepted or economically settled states
community_model.scope_boundary: Community discussion does not alter released protocol/runtime semantics, qualification evidence, rights or settlement state

news_model.name: Blackmore Technology GitHub Footprint NEWS
news_model.schedule: twice hourly at minute 7 and 37 plus manual/push triggers
news_model.scope: public Blackmore Technology GitHub footprint only; private repositories and private activity excluded
news_model.history_rule: current repository/release/PR state is refreshed each sync; previously observed public activity is append-retained from the first automated NEWS sync forward because GitHub public events are a rolling recent window
claim_boundaries: GitHub activity is not automatically ENTITY evidence
fork or repository custody is not upstream ownership
external pull request is not upstream acceptance
ENTITY ingestion is not independent validation
upstream merge is not payment or economic settlement

capability_surfaces: authorized settlement verifiers and payment attestations
ADAM deterministic state transformation and replay
retention, legal hold and evidenced destruction
standards adapters and industry implementation packages

btdu_storage_benchmark.scope: controlled tested BTDU benchmark; not asserted as a universal percentage for every workload

btdu_destruction_recovery.scope: qualified destruction/cold-recovery campaign; Memnox recovered 865/865 tracked blobs plus archive, manifest and acceptance proof without original workspace, Git, GitHub or network

external_contribution_lineage.boundary: upstream acceptance does not automatically establish payment, ownership transfer or execution of every market subsystem

claim_boundaries: sovereignty is not the whole product
hosting or custody is not authority
provenance is not automatically ownership or objective truth
trade execution is not verified external settlement

Legacy generated reference counts and historical qualification remain explicitly historical. This manifest does not alter ENTITY protocol semantics, runtime qualification, immutable release evidence, upstream rights, settlement evidence or historical tags.
